authorization: User requests MEND, GRACE, BalancEdit, LoRA T4/T5 on the current experiments.

T4.bank: Same combined T4G/T4L order as frozen MDU bank

T5.bank: Same predeclared global image-role-safe subset/order as MDU

selection: Reuse unchanged frozen CORE Base eligibility, native/FIT inputs, image rendering, prompt tokens and task probes. No new Base selection, test tuning or cohort expansion.

BALANCEDIT.training: Native only, first frozen FIT as positive radius anchor, black-image negative anchor
BALANCEDIT.bank: Independent per-edit writers and true original ordered R0 bank, consistent with existing project comparator; this adaptation is not claimed identical to author hidden implementation

GRACE.replacement: replace_prompt through expanded final prompt position; prefill-only cache-consistent generation
GRACE.training: Native only; exact label-token collision semantics
GRACE.bank: Real stateful sequential insertion, not independent single averaging
GRACE.prior_grace_correction: Separate experiment from earlier 50-step L2 layer27 reference; earlier results unchanged

LORA.training: Native only, fixed 5 epochs; no success-driven stopping
LORA.bank: Cumulative LoRA updates in same frozen sequence; no R0 gating

MEND.requirement: Trained meta-editor for exact LLaVA-Med-v1.5/Mistral backbone with independent edit-training and locality data provenance
MEND.observed: Benchmark public release contains data/task builders, no trained editors. Checked EasyEdit MEND configs include Mistral text, BLIP2 and MiniGPT4, but no verified exact LLaVA-Med multimodal editor checkpoint.
MEND.no_substitution: Do not call ordinary gradient steps or random meta-network MEND; do not train on this evaluation cohort.
MEND.followup: Continue bounded source/artifact verification while the three executable methods run.

precision: FP32 decoder with frozen FP16 multimodal prefill for matched Base/MDU inference. Frozen backbone; no precision search. First source query per cohort must reproduce stored Base tokens; first actual edit must pass save/load generation parity; GRACE also fixed 16-token cache/no-cache parity.

scoring.unknown: Exact failed/conflicting historical payloads remain UNKNOWN; only exact same contract text payloads reused

metrics: Same T4 edit-macro pre-wrong Fix/pre-correct Retention; T5 frozen no-introduced-error/all-edits plus pre-correct retention, pre-wrong fix, followup accuracy and delta; explicit denominators and 11/01/10 strata. FIT diagnostic only.
fairness: Standard native-only comparator optimization and five-view MDU training differ and must be disclosed. T4 probes are shared; T5 is dominated by persistent-positive cases. No independent-confirmation or guaranteed-superiority claim.

resources.clock_start: First actual comparator GPU/model execution; all methods/cohorts/repairs/scoring share one clock, no reset
resources.checkpoint_lifecycle: T4 method states consumed and exactly retired before T5 bank; keep output/token/config/failure evidence. No existing data/model/MDU/MED/M13P deletion.
